personal.name: Soumita Bhattacharya Sen
personal.title: Senior BI Developer | Data Analyst | AI Enthusiast
personal.summary: Detail-oriented and highly analytical Data Analyst and BI Developer with over 8 years of experience. Proven expertise in transforming complex data sets into intuitive, interactive dashboards that drive strategic business decisions. Specializes in Power BI, Tableau, and advanced SQL data modeling. Passionate about uncovering the 'why' behind the numbers and delivering quiet luxury in data visualization.
personal.built_by: Designed and Built with ❤️ by Debayan Sen.

highlights: Architected scalable Power BI data models handling 50M+ rows of transactional data.
Collaborated with executive stakeholders to define key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.

experience.description: Supported core business operations, facilitating employee development and analyzing training metrics.
highlights: Delivered impactful communications training to optimize team efficiency and stakeholder interactions.
Maintained performance dashboards to track trainee progress and program effectiveness.

recommendations.name: Aman Verma
recommendations.text: Soumita is an exceptional BI developer. Her ability to translate vague stakeholder requirements into crystal-clear, performant dashboards is unmatched. She brings both technical excellence and a keen eye for design to every project.

recommendations.name: Priya Sharma
recommendations.text: Working with Soumita was an absolute pleasure. She has a meticulous approach to data validation and always ensures that the insights presented are 100% accurate and actionable. A true asset to any data team.
